section_summary.extract_value: This section presents factor structure analysis for the female subsample using 10 items from the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2). Parallel analysis indicated a single-factor solution explaining 48.4% of variance, with acceptable internal consistency (Cronbach's α = .87). The analysis includes KMO and Bartlett's test results confirming factorability of the correlation matrix.
